messages:
olivia: Hi team, new hire here. I can't finish cloud onboarding: GCP project 789012345678 shows "No billing account linked" and I get a 403 when trying to create a VM in asia-south1. Also blocked from creating service account keys. Who should I ping? :wave:

marc: welcome @olivia! paste the exact errors if possible and we'll triage.

olivia: VM error:
```
ERROR: PERMISSION_DENIED: Policy 'constraints/compute.restrictRegions' prevents creating resources in asia-south1.
```
SA key error:
```
ERROR: PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.serviceAccountKeys.create denied on resource project 789012345678.
Details: Org policy prevents key creation.
```
Billing UI says "You don't have permission to link a billing account".

ops: looks like the project landed in a restricted folder. I'll open INFRA-20001 to: 1) move project to onboarding-sandbox, 2) attach billingAccounts/1010-2020-3030, 3) grant roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin and roles/billing.projectManager for onboarding. ETA ~45m.

infra-bot: Org policy scan: project 789012345678 denies SA key creation and restricts regions to [us-central1,europe-west1]. INFRA-20001 created and assigned to ops.

olivia: thanks! also our terraform needs an AWS assume-role and SSO shows no rdw-deploy target, so CI fails. Who approves SSO?

sso-bot: Submit an SSO request with target role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-deploy and include your Okta email. If your Okta lacks group `infra-dev` request it in the same INFRA ticket; ops can add the group so SSO auto-approves.

ops: adding Okta action to INFRA-20001 to ensure infra-dev membership for olivia and patching SSO mapping. Please submit SSO REQ id here once you file.

security: quick FYI  region exceptions for asia require a one-line justification if any customer data will be used. If it's demo/synthetic data only we can fast-track.

olivia: demo data only, no customer PII. Filed SSO request REQ-99999 and updated INFRA-20001. Thanks everyone, I'll test after ops moves the project. :pray:

ops: INFRA-20001 update: project moved to onboarding-sandbox, billingAccounts/1010-2020-3030 linked, roles granted for onboarding. Waiting on SSO REQ-99999 approval for AWS role. Please confirm when you can create a VM in allowed regions.

olivia: confirmed I can now create service accounts and VMs in us-central1. REQ-99999 is pending approval; will report back when approved. Appreciate the help!
